# awscc_apiportal_product_page (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::ProductPage



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `display_content` (Attributes) The displayed content of the product page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_content))
- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product.
- `product_page_arn` (String) The ARN of the product page.
- `product_page_id` (String) The product page identifier.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the product page was last modified.
